full_judgment: 8. As regards defect of parties, the High Court Division held hat Order I, rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure makes it clear that misjoinder or non-joinder of parties is not fatal to a suit provided the suit is of such a nature that the rights and interests of the parties before the Court can be effectively disposed of without the presence of parties not joined and that in the present case, the transferees of the defendant No. 1 will stand or fall along with the said defendant No. 1 and so in their absence the right, title and interest of the parties may be effectively disposed of and so the suit will not fail for non-joinder of the parties who purchased lands from the defendant No. 1.
